description: Parallel isolated proposals followed by rubric-based synthesis and verification.

nodes.objective: Define one shared problem statement, constraints and judging rubric.
acceptance: All candidates receive equivalent task context.
Rubric is fixed before candidate outputs are inspected.

nodes.objective: Produce independent candidate designs or implementations in isolated contexts/worktrees.
acceptance: Candidates do not read each other's outputs before completion.
Each candidate provides tradeoffs and evidence.

nodes.objective: Compare candidates against the predeclared rubric, not popularity.
acceptance: Strengths and failures are mapped to rubric criteria.

nodes.objective: Implement or synthesize the chosen direction without carrying incompatible parts.
acceptance: Integrated result has one coherent architecture.
Blocking verification and security findings are resolved or escalated.
